\caption{Handler cost swept (GIL build unless stated). The horizontal axis is the measured time one request holds the GIL on one worker. (a)~Scaling at four workers. The free-threaded series has no points for the three handler sizes added in the supplementary run. (b)~Throughput at four workers relative to \code{uringpy} processes with GIL batching (grey line): worker threads of one interpreter (solid) and the two baselines run as one process per worker through the Protocol API (dashed). Bars are 95\% half-widths.}
